INSERT INTO t_csys_teaching_plan_support_objective ( plan_id, ref_type, ref_plan_id, ref_course_id, objective_id, purpose_id, item_name, item_type_name, major_id, sort, creator, create_time, last_modifier, last_modified_time, remark, sysflag ) VALUES

mapper.select: SELECT so.id, so.plan_id, so.ref_type, so.ref_plan_id, so.ref_course_id, so.objective_id, so.purpose_id, COALESCE(o.content, p.purpose, so.item_name) AS item_name, so.item_type_name AS item_type_name, COALESCE(o.major_id, so.major_id) AS major_id, so.sort, so.creator, so.create_time, so.last_modifier, so.last_modified_time, so.remark, so.sysflag FROM t_csys_teaching_plan_support_objective so LEFT JOIN t_csys_teaching_plan_objective o ON so.ref_type = 1 AND o.id = so.objective_id AND o.sysflag = 0 LEFT JOIN t_csys_teaching_plan_training_purpose p ON so.ref_type = 2 AND p.id = so.purpose_id AND p.sysflag = 0 WHERE so.plan_id = #{planId} AND so.sysflag = 0 ORDER BY so.sort ASC, so.id ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE t_csys_teaching_plan_support_objective SET sysflag = 2 WHERE plan_id = #{planId}
